item.tib: sa bdag dbang chen yid bzhin ljon pa'i phreng ba las sngon 'gro sa chog gi rim pa me tog gi phreng ba
item.coloph: bla ma'i lung don snyan du brgyud/ dus dang skabs la 'phrad pa'i tshe/ dad ldan tshul rgyal nan bskul ngor/ 'gru rigs gsang sngags grags de yis/ sa rtar thar bde yi ger bkod/ nyes 'gal byung na gong mar bzod/ dge ba'i 'gro la phan thogs cig phyams gcig g.yung drung sar 'god shog/
